title: Natural Resources Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Geography Natural Resources Chapter

cards.q: Resources obtained from the biosphere that have life, such as flora and fauna, are called what?
Resources composed of non-living things, such as rocks and metals, are known as what?
Solar energy, wind energy, water, and forests are examples of which type of resources based on exhaustibility?
Which type of resources occur over a very long geological time and include minerals and fossil fuels?
Village commons, grazing grounds, and public parks are examples of which type of resource ownership?
Which major crops are primarily grown in the Black Soil regions of Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Gujarat?
What is the primary cause of soil becoming alkaline and unsuitable for cultivation due to unscientific irrigation?
Name the two major organizations engaged in the exploration and development of mineral resources in India.
cards.a: Geological Survey of India (GSI) and Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM).

cards.q: Which resource management strategy is considered better than recycling because it does not consume additional energy?
Forests are often referred to by what valuable term due to their economic and ecological importance?
Forests act as a natural 'sponge' and help regulate the climate by absorbing which gas?
In which year was the Forest (Conservation) Act enacted in India to prevent the diversion of forests for non-forest purposes?
Where is the Forest Research Institute (FRI) established for research in forestry development located?
On what date is World Forestry Day observed every year?
